items.title: 67255_Helen Humes oral history interview
items.q: No, I've been over there - whenever I go to Europe I go there. And if I don't get there they come where I am.

ctx.x: And they'd say, okay we made reservations for you. We got reservations for you and then they would take me to this nice hotel, a suite and everything. And I stay there and they would come and get me every day to come over to have my meals and everything. And then when it was time to go and I had to go to the airport and I would ask for my bill and they would say, no, no, Dr. Chavron paid that. And I would say, 'he did?'
Isn't that nice. Did you go over to them twice or just the once?
